_doc: Pages published to https://austegard.com/experiments/ by .github/workflows/pages.yml. Opt-in: an experiment's HTML is served only when listed here. `path` is a file or a directory (a directory ships its web files: html, js, css, json, images, fonts, wasm). `url` instead links a page hosted elsewhere. Built by _lib/pages_site.py, which fails on a missing path.
